witness.quote: not drive abreast of or overtake the authorized emergency vehicle or official vehicle of a regulatory agency.
witness.reason: The emergency vehicle can be the distinct participant with which ego intends to travel abreast.
required_context: Confirm driver scope, vehicle classification, independent emergency authorization, qualifying equipment and officer directions.
Establish the distinct abreast participants, lane boundaries, lateral clearance and routes; adjacent lanes do not require same-lane occupancy.
Establish traversable adjacent lanes, separate vehicle routes, dimensions and lateral clearance.
Preserve approaching and abreast without legal geometric or duration thresholds; preparation alone cannot replace same-direction movement.
Retain an initial ego approach followed by same-direction emergency-vehicle movement and flashing-light use during the observed episode.
Retain an initial subject approach and time-resolved positions, headings, velocities and extents through the abreast episode.
Supply authorization and qualifying equipment facts, and record any officer directions.
witness.subject_reason: A motor-vehicle driver is a compatible driver of another vehicle; retain identity and the applicable NRS 484A.080 control facts.
